title: Zelensky slams 'absolute depravity' after massive Russian drone attack
summary: Russia launched a massive attack on Ukraine in broad daylight on March 25, firing hundreds of drones into the territory. It comes after Russia fired nearly 1,000 drones in a 24-hour period, killing a total of eight people across the country. This record attack had hit Lviv's historic centre and residential houses in the west of the country.
